expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: the 2025 email trial left reminders unopened and doubled
missed pickups, which is why reminders go by SMS.
expectations.evidence: The message states that email was tried April–June 2025, missed pickups rose from 6% to 13%, and 34% of reminders went unopened, causing food waste and prompting the return to SMS. It asks, "Want me to proceed anyway, or look for a cheaper SMS provider / hybrid approach instead?"

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/reminders.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/reminders.md at step 2; first edit at step None

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back the missed pickups and thrown-away food of the 2025 email trial.
expectations.evidence: The agent left the change out and asked before proceeding, explaining that the 2025 email trial caused missed pickups to nearly double (6%→13%), “costing real food waste.”
